desc:
🎨 Color Your Favorite Anime Characters - Pixel by Pixel!
Dive into a relaxing and creative experience where you bring iconic anime characters to life through pixel art!

🔥 New anime characters added regularly!
Got a favorite character you'd love to see? Like the game and join our community to share your suggestions:
👉 https://www.roblox.com/communities/36075998/Open-Fields#!/about

💾 Your progress is saved automatically - pick up right where you left off anytime!

🐞 Found a bug or have an idea?
Join our dev group to report issues and help shape the future of the game:
👉 https://www.roblox.com/communities/36075998/Open-Fields#!/about

👍 Like the game if you're having fun!
Your support helps us grow and add even more awesome content!

Tags: Coloring, Color, Pixel Art, Anime, Paint, Drawing, Easy, Fun, Relax, Cute
